note: One cut per role, 17 October 2026: "there must be a differentiation from an agent to a sales support to the branch manager to the unit manager". Every name, hour and figure on screen is made up. The hours are the tracker's own schedule; where the branch's real shifts differ, the Day Blocks tab is what changes, not this file.

scenes.headline: Your day is already written down
scenes.line: Sales support. Your day is already written down. Four blocks, two mail sweeps, and one list before you leave.
scenes.tail: Nothing here asks you to type what a system can already see

scenes.headline: The branch does not work one shift
scenes.line: You sign in when you arrive. Some of us are in at seven. Some leave at two. The board reads your own hours, not somebody else's.
scenes.note: A block is never late against a day you did not work.

scenes.headline: Filed in the tracker, read here
scenes.line: Your blocks come straight from the daily tracker. Nothing is logged twice. KPI one is in. Reporting is late. The afternoon has not started.

blocks.did: Tested the premium due desk against the dues extract

scenes.headline: Three lines, and two answer themselves
scenes.line: At a quarter to four the tracker asks what has to be true before you leave. Three of those lines answer themselves off the sheet. You are only asked about the one it cannot see.

items.item: Anything you were written to about, or fell short on, noted

scenes.foot: Your list is set on the tracker. The Who column decides whose list each line is on.

scenes.headline: The record already knows who supports it
scenes.line: And what came to your desk this morning was not assigned by anybody. Every stuck application already names the person supporting it. Sixty one of them are on yours.
scenes.note: Carrying one million, two hundred and forty thousand dollars of API. The oldest is six hundred and forty days old.

words3: File your blocks as you finish them.
Clear the list before you leave.
scenes.line: Sign in when you arrive. File your blocks as you finish them. Clear the list before you leave. That is the whole of it.
